Skips assets exceeding max_asset_size limit

```swift title="Swift"
import Crawlberg

let engineConfig = try crawlConfigFromJson("{\"download_assets\":true,\"max_asset_size\":150}")
let engineObj = try createEngine(config: engineConfig)
let url = "https://example.com"
let result = try await Crawlberg.scrape(engine: engineObj, url: url)
print(result)
```
